text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 256 million markka median forecast for Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy's January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax.
(Profit forecasts by 10 analysts, EPS by five analysts).
Rautaruukki's four-month results are due on June 11 at 0930/0630 GMT.
In January-April 1996, Rautaruukki posted a profit before extraordinaries and tax of 357 million markka.
In February, Rautaruukki said it expected improving earnings and rising net sales in 1997.
The median of seven analysts' forecasts for Rautaruukki's full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax was 970 million markka (mean 991 million) in a 910-1,129 million markka range.
In 1996, Rautaruukki's profit was 715 million markka.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Evli Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Merita Securities, Opstock Securities and Postipankki.
